summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV filed a Form 6-K disclosing repurchases under its previously announced buyback program. Between October 5 and October 9, 2026, the Belgian biotech repurchased 126,322 ordinary shares through an independent financial intermediary's discretionary mandate at a volume-weighted average of EUR 26.26, for EUR 3,317,407.94, across XAMS, TQEX, CEUX and AQEU. As of the October 9 close, Lakefront holds 1,877,353 treasury shares. No price, premium or close date beyond the daily purchase data is stated. Watch ongoing buyback pace and treasury-share accumulation versus capital-allocation signals.
